title: Closed immersion derived tensor projection formula
statement: Let Lambda be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], k a field, and S,X schemes separated, quasi-compact and locally of finite type over Spec k. Let f:S -> X be a closed immersion over Spec k. On ordinary unbounded derived categories [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories], with relative derived tensor [def-sfb-derived-tensor-modules], E=Rf_* [def-sfb-module-lower-star] satisfies a natural isomorphism E(M) tensor_X N = E(M tensor_S f^*N), where f^* is coefficient-compatible upperStar [def-sfb-module-upper-star]. This is an isomorphism of bifunctors with no boundedness or Tor-amplitude hypothesis.

source.place: Closed immersions, sheaves; Derived version. This is a strictly smaller immersion case of det-lem-int-tensor-projection.

proof.text:
the standing hypotheses make X Noetherian, hence its open complement of the
closed image is quasi-compact. Apply openClosedSupportProjectionFormula to f and this
complement; its first component makes the canonical closed projection invertible.
Assemble the normalized supportDerivedTensorComparison into a natural isomorphism of
curried bifunctors with a generic private helper: specialize two-variable naturality
at the identity in either variable and rewrite the corresponding functor identities. Form the rightAdjointProjectionMap of the closed pullback
adjunction with this comparison. Its components equal the normalized closed projection
maps, by the unit formula for homEquiv and functoriality of composition. They are
therefore isomorphisms; pointwise detection twice makes the bifunctor map an
isomorphism. Transport the pullback along supportPullbackIsoUpperStar and the exact
closed direct image along rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory. These operations
preserve both naturality variables. Empty complements, zero coefficients and unbounded
complexes require no separate argument.

lean.statement:
theorem closedImmersionTensorProjection
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {S X : Scheme.{u}}
    [S.Over (Spec (.of k))] [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (S ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (S ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (S ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (f : S ⟶ X) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsClosedImmersion f] :
    Nonempty (
      (((Functor.whiskeringLeft₂ _).obj
          (lowerStar Λ f).rightDerivedFunctor).obj (𝟭 _)).obj
        (derivedTensor Λ X) ≅
      (Functor.postcompose₂.obj
        (lowerStar Λ f).rightDerivedFunctor).obj
        ((((Functor.whiskeringLeft₂ _).obj (𝟭 _)).obj
          ((f)^*⟦Λ⟧.mapDerivedCategory)).obj (derivedTensor Λ S)))
